title: Intake: warn-and-reconfirm when goals+scope are all empty despite a substantive problem_statement
description:
From the 2026-07-18 intake+KB-graph design review (Q1 Option 2). No ambiguity/contradiction detection exists in the intake pipeline; src/question-engine.js validation is per-field required/enum/validate only (src/question-engine.js:118-186). Add a lightweight post-definition check: when problem_statement is non-trivial but goals AND scope_in AND scope_out are ALL empty, warn (naming the empty sections) and re-confirm.

HUMAN SCOPE DECISION (2026-07-18): warn-but-allow posture. Do NOT make goals/scope required — TASK-048 deliberately kept them optional; this surfaces the gap without reversing that call.
acceptance_criteria: In the CLI wizard, when problem_statement is non-empty/non-trivial and goals+scope_in+scope_out are all empty, the user sees a warning naming the empty sections and is asked to reconfirm; proceeding is allowed and answers are still written.
The check NEVER hard-blocks: goals/scope_in/scope_out stay optional (TASK-048 preserved); a user who confirms proceeds with empty sections.
Non-interactive runs (--yes / answers-mode) are not broken — the warn path degrades to a non-blocking notice or is skipped per existing skipConfirm semantics, proven by spec.
tdd: validation/flow logic + fixtures; existing wizard specs stay green.
